name: Lokman Hekim Engurusag Saglik, Turizm, Egitim Hizmetleri ve Insaat Taahhut A.S.
summary: Lokman Hekim Engürüsag Saglik, Turizm, Egitim Hizmetleri ve Insaat Taahhüt A.S. owns and operates hospitals in Turkey. It offers various medical and laboratory services. The company was founded in 1996 and is headquartered in Ankara, Turkey.
